response: CALL run_sql {"sql": "SELECT c.category_nm, SUM(ol.line_amt) as revenue FROM ord_ln ol JOIN ord_hdr oh ON ol.ord_id = oh.ord_id JOIN prod_ref pr ON ol.prod_id = pr.prod_id JOIN category_dim c ON pr.category_cd = c.category_cd WHERE oh.sts_cd <> 'X' GROUP BY c.category_nm ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3"}
